gloss: efficiently; deftly; in a well-organized manner

definitions.gloss: efficiently; deftly; in a well-organized manner
definitions.explanation: Doing something in a smart, organized way that gets good results without wasting time or effort.

examples.japanese: {要領|ようりょう}よく⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}けた→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{要領|ようりょう}よく⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧やすい。
examples.english: She explains things in a well-organized way, so it's easy to understand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{限|かぎ}られた→限る：02033_kagiru⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{要領|ようりょう}よく⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めない→進める：01949_susumeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{本番|ほんばん}→本番：19392_honban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わない→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧。
examples.english: If we don't prepare efficiently within the limited time, we won't make it in time for the real thing.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{要領|ようりょう}→要領：14109_youryou⟧ (the knack; the key point) + ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧ (well). Describes someone who grasps the essentials quickly and acts on them without wasted motion. Can carry a slightly envious or even mildly negative connotation — implying someone is shrewd or cuts corners skillfully.

The opposite is ⟦{要領|ようりょう}が{悪|わる}い→要領が悪い：20144_youryougawarui⟧ (to be bad at getting things done efficiently; clumsy in approach).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {要領|ようりょう}よく⟦こなす→こなす：09897_konasu⟧: to handle efficiently
- {要領|ようりょう}よく⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧: to summarize concisely
- {要領|ようりょう}よく⟦{立|た}ち{回|まわ}る→立ち回る：18595_tachimawaru⟧: to maneuver deftly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手際|てぎわ}よく: skillfully; deftly — emphasizes smooth execution of a task
- ⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧: efficiently — more neutral and objective
- ⟦{器用|きよう}→器用：02655_kiyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: skillfully; adroitly — emphasizes inherent dexterity
